#### PhyloCactus

![](../assets/img/phylocactus-logo.png){.card-logo fig-alt="PhyloCactus logo"}

A 13-module workflow for Cactaceae phylogenetics: GenBank mining, alignment, saturation screening, model selection, constrained maximum-likelihood inference with RAxML-NG, dating with treePL, IUCN Red List integration and validation against published trees. It includes a DNA-barcoding module to identify cactus samples.

[GitHub](https://github.com/beeamerino/PhyloCactus) · [Documentation](https://beeamerino.github.io/PhyloCactus/)
:::

::: pcard
[Tutorial · in Spanish]{.kicker}

#### MappingR: spatial data visualization in R

A step-by-step tutorial (BIODATA, 2024) for publication-quality maps: administrative boundaries, climate, soil and elevation data, hillshade relief, hypsometric palettes, scale bars and location maps with sf, terra, ggplot2 and tidyterra.

[Tutorial](https://beeamerino.github.io/BIODATA-MappingR/MappingR.html) · [GitHub](https://github.com/beeamerino/BIODATA-MappingR)
:::

::: pcard
[Shiny app · in development]{.kicker}

#### Climatic Stability

Evaluates the climatic suitability of farmland (for example, vineyards) under past (Last Interglacial, LGM, mid-Holocene), present and future (CMIP6) climates. It is built with terra, biomod2, CHELSA/PaleoClim climate layers, Leaflet maps and an automated Quarto report.

*Code not yet published.*
:::
::::::

## Technical skills

::: {.software-table}
| Area | What I do | Tools |
|---|---|---|
| Phylogenetic inference | Maximum-likelihood and Bayesian inference, model and partition selection, node support (bootstrap, TBE), coalescent species trees | RAxML-NG, IQ-TREE, MrBayes, ModelTest-NG, PartitionFinder, ASTRAL-III |
| Molecular dating | Divergence times with calibrations and temporal uncertainty | treePL |
| Phylogeny comparison | Topological congruence and tree space (Robinson-Foulds, information distances) | TreeDist, phangorn, ape |
| Macroevolution | Diversification rates and regimes | BAMM, MiSSE (hisse), DR, diversitree, phytools |
| Historical biogeography | Ancestral range reconstruction and biogeographic stochastic mapping | BioGeoBEARS (BSM) |
| Population genetics | Structure, ancestry and genetic diversity | RAD-seq SNPs, microsatellites, STRUCTURE, DAPC |
| Sequences and curation | GenBank mining, alignment, masking and quality control | phylotaR, rentrez, MAFFT, DECIPHER, trimAl, Biostrings |
| Statistics and machine learning | Linear mixed models, model selection (AIC), cross-validation, multivariate analysis and clustering | glmmTMB, tidymodels, ranger, xgboost, FactoMineR, cluster |
| Spatial analysis and species distribution models (SDM) | Species distribution modeling under past, present and future climates; remote sensing | biomod2, terra, sf, CHELSA, PaleoClim, QGIS, Landsat, drone photogrammetry, NDVI |
| Biodiversity data | Occurrence records, standards and taxonomic reconciliation | GBIF (rgbif), Darwin Core, taxize, Caryophyllales.org, IUCN Red List API |
| Programming and reproducibility | Library development, visualization, web applications and automated workflows | R (tidyverse, ggplot2, ggtree), devtools, testthat, pkgdown, Shiny, Quarto, Git, GitHub Actions, Python, high-performance computing (NLHPC) |
| Laboratory | Molecular biology and ecophysiology | DNA extraction from recalcitrant tissues, PCR, sequencing preparation, flow cytometry, stable isotopes |
:::
